meta.name: decision-journal
meta.description: Record project decisions with context, rationale, and confidence. Use when making or revisiting decisions about game development — engine, genre, art style, tools, architecture, learning path. Prevents decision amnesia and ADHD re-evaluation loops.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录决策背景与信心,避免反复推翻
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做选择后总忍不住反复推翻自己
copy.tagline_en: Log decisions with context and confidence to stop second-guessing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep second-guessing your past choices.

howto.what: 它会把重大决策记成结构化条目（背景、理由、备选、后果、复盘触发条件、信心等级），存进 decisions/ 文件夹并按编号排列；只记录会限制未来选项的决策。
howto.when: 当你做出或重新审视游戏开发的关键决策时（如引擎、类型、美术风格等），或发现自己在反复纠结已定的事时。

say.text: 我刚决定用 Godot 做这款游戏，帮我记一条决策日志。
say.note: 自动套用模板写入 decisions/ 编号文件。

say.text: 查一下我之前对美术风格的决策，触发条件满足了吗？
say.note: 检查已有记录和复盘触发条件。

say.text: 这个引擎决策我有点想推翻，帮我看看当初的理由。
say.note: 对照触发条件判断是否该重审。

howto.what_en: It records major decisions as structured entries (context, rationale, alternatives, consequences, revisit triggers, confidence), saves them to a decisions/ folder with sequential numbering, and only logs decisions that constrain future options.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you make or revisit a key game-development decision (engine, genre, art style, etc.), or when you find yourself re-evaluating something already decided.

say_en.text: I just decided to use Godot for this game. Log a decision entry for me.
say_en.note: Automatically writes a numbered file in decisions/.

say_en.text: Check my earlier art-style decision. Has its revisit trigger been met?
say_en.note: Looks up the entry and tests the trigger.

say_en.text: I'm tempted to overturn the engine choice. Show me why I picked it.
say_en.note: Compares the original rationale against the trigger.
